senses.en: the sense of what is right and wrong

ex.en: His conscience would not let him cheat.
ex.zh: 他的良心不允许他作弊。

ex.en: She listened to her conscience and returned the wallet she had found on the bus.
ex.zh: 她听从良心，把在公交车上捡到的钱包还了回去。

tip: conscience 中间有 science 的形，但意思是良心。意识是 consciousness。

senses.en: to move very fast, or to make a camera image larger
a camera setting that changes how close things look

ex.en: Bikes zoom past the library steps.
ex.zh: 自行车从图书馆台阶边飞驰而过。

ex.en: Zoom in on the label so the expiry date is large enough to read without guessing.
ex.zh: 把镜头拉近到标签上，让保质期大到不用猜就能看清。

tip: zoom in 拉近，zoom out 拉远。车子飞驰也可以用 zoom。第一义是动词。

senses.en: a crash between moving things

ex.en: The collision blocked the bridge for an hour.
ex.zh: 这场碰撞让桥堵了一个小时。

ex.en: No one was hurt in the collision, but both mirrors lay in pieces on the road.
ex.zh: 碰撞中没有人受伤，但两面镜子都碎在路上。

tip: collision 是名词。动词是 collide with。

senses.en: a small enclosed stall

ex.en: Wait in the phone booth; I'll be one minute.
ex.zh: 在电话亭里等一下，我一分钟就来。

ex.en: Each club had a booth in the gym, with a sign and a signup sheet.
ex.zh: 每个社团在体育馆里都有一个小隔间，挂着牌子和报名表。

tip: 参考表音标写成了 /buːð/。booth 的辅音是 /θ/，本卡不采用那条音标。

senses.en: a nut with a hard wrinkled shell

ex.en: A walnut cracked under the spoon.
ex.zh: 一颗核桃在勺子下裂开了。

ex.en: She added a chopped walnut to the salad, after checking that nobody at the table had a nut allergy.
ex.zh: 她确认同桌没有人对坚果过敏之后，才把切碎的核桃加进沙拉。

tip: walnut 是核桃。复数 walnuts。坚果过敏在共享食物时要先问，这是生活礼貌。

senses.en: towards the back
directed back, or less developed

ex.en: Lean backward only if someone holds the chair.
ex.zh: 有人扶着椅子再向后靠。

ex.en: A backward glance showed that the queue was still at the tree, not at the door.
ex.zh: 他向后看了一眼，队伍还在树那儿，没有到门口。

tip: backward 可作副词或形容词。带 s 的 backwards 已在库里。形容地区「落后」时语气重，少用。
note: backward 与已在库里的 backwards 分开列出。

senses.en: an ancient stone monument, or a solid with triangular sides meeting at a point

ex.en: The pyramid throws a long shadow.
ex.zh: 金字塔投下长长的影子。

ex.en: In maths a pyramid has a point at the top, and the base can be a square.
ex.zh: 数学里的棱锥顶部是一个点，底可以是正方形。

tip: 埃及金字塔和几何棱锥都是 pyramid。专名前可加 the：the Great Pyramid。

senses.en: to take back, or to take money out

ex.en: You can withdraw cash at the machine by the gate.
ex.zh: 你可以在门口的机器上取现金。

ex.en: She withdrew her name from the race after the doctor looked at her ankle.
ex.zh: 医生看过她的脚踝后，她退出了比赛。

tip: 过去式 withdrew，过去分词 withdrawn。取钱和退出比赛都用这个动词。

senses.en: a woman whose husband has died

ex.en: The widow next door teaches piano on Saturdays.
ex.zh: 隔壁的遗孀星期六教钢琴。

ex.en: In the novel the widow keeps her husband's letters in a tin under the bed.
ex.zh: 小说里，这位遗孀把丈夫的信放在床下一个铁盒里。

tip: 参考表没有 widow 这一行。鳏夫是 widower。

senses.en: something added to make a place or object look special

ex.en: Paper stars were the only decoration.
ex.zh: 装饰只有纸星星。

ex.en: The decoration on the window must come down before the exam notices are taped there.
ex.zh: 考试通知贴上去之前，窗户上的装饰得先取下来。

tip: 动词是 decorate。一件饰品是 a decoration，节日里常用复数 decorations。

senses.en: a rule or fact that limits what you can do

ex.en: The restriction on phones starts today.
ex.zh: 手机限制从今天开始。

ex.en: One restriction remains: visitors may enter the lab only with a teacher beside them.
ex.zh: 还有一条限制：参观者只能在老师陪同下进实验室。

tip: restriction on sth。动词 restrict sb / sth。没有限制是 without restriction。

senses.en: to hold firmly, or to understand
an understanding of something

ex.en: Grasp the rope with both hands.
ex.zh: 用两只手抓住绳子。

ex.en: Once you grasp the rule, the later exercises take much less time to finish.
ex.zh: 一旦理解这条规则，后面的练习就省事得多。

col: a good grasp of｜对…掌握得好
tip: grasp 可以是手里抓住，也可以是脑子里弄懂。

senses.en: an instrument that shows direction, or one that draws circles

ex.en: The compass needle points north.
ex.zh: 指南针的针指向北。

ex.en: Draw the circle with a compass, and do not use a cup if the radius must be exact.
ex.zh: 用圆规画圆；半径必须准确时不要用杯子代替。

col: a pair of compasses｜一副圆规
tip: 指南针是 a compass。圆规常说 a pair of compasses。两个意思都要看句子。

senses.en: to make fun of someone, sometimes unkindly

ex.en: Do not tease him about his accent.
ex.zh: 不要拿他的口音取笑。

ex.en: Friends may tease one another lightly, but the joke stops when the other person stops smiling.
ex.zh: 朋友之间可以轻轻逗一逗，可是对方不再笑的时候，玩笑就该停。

tip: tease sb about sth。善意的逗和伤人的嘲弄不一样，对方不舒服就要停。名词 a tease 不如动词常见。

senses.en: a plant used to flavour food or in medicine

ex.en: This soup needs one fresh herb.
ex.zh: 这汤需要一种新鲜香草。

ex.en: The herb garden behind the kitchen grows mint, and students may smell it but not pick it.
ex.zh: 厨房后面的香草园种着薄荷，学生可以闻，不能摘。

tip: 英式 herb 的 h 常不发音，美式多发音。形容词 herbal。

senses.en: to state officially
to officially report goods, income or other required information

ex.en: The mayor will declare the festival open.
ex.zh: 市长将宣布节日开幕。

ex.en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。

col: declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态
tip: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

senses.en: to press something firmly from opposite sides

ex.en: Squeeze the cloth before you hang it up.
ex.zh: 把布拧干再挂起来。

ex.en: We had to squeeze into the last row because the earlier seats were already taken.
ex.zh: 前面的位子满了，我们只好挤进最后一排。

tip: squeeze into 是勉强挤进。把汁挤出来是 squeeze out。

senses.en: facts and figures

ex.en: Scientists collect data from tests.
ex.zh: 科学家从实验中收集数据。

ex.en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

tip: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

senses.en: to look at something carefully, often in an official way

ex.en: Inspect the cable for a crack.
ex.zh: 检查电线有没有裂口。

ex.en: Officials inspect the kitchen twice a year, and the canteen must show how it stores milk and meat.
ex.zh: 官员一年两次视察厨房，食堂必须说明牛奶和肉类如何存放。

col: inspect for damage｜检查有无损坏
tip: inspect 比 look at 更仔细，也常带官方意味。名词 inspection，人是 inspector。

senses.en: a thin thread of natural or artificial material

ex.en: This rope is made of plant fiber.
ex.zh: 这根绳子是植物纤维做的。

ex.en: The label lists fiber as the main material, not plastic.
ex.zh: 标签把纤维列为主要材料，不是塑料。

tip: 考纲另有 fibre。参考表把 fiber 标成 fibre 的美式拼写，中文是纤维质。本卡记作纤维。

senses.en: to put something into something else

ex.en: Insert the key and turn it to the left.
ex.zh: 把钥匙插入，向左转。

ex.en: Insert the cable before you open the file, or the screen stays blank.
ex.zh: 先插上线再打开文件，否则屏幕一直是空的。

tip: 动词重音常在后：insert。名词「插入物」重音常在前。参考表这一行是及物动词。

senses.en: a person who is among the first to do something
to be the first to develop something

ex.en: She is a pioneer of village libraries.
ex.zh: 她是乡村图书馆的开拓者。

ex.en: The lab pioneered a cheap test, and other schools copied it the following year.
ex.zh: 实验室率先做出一种便宜的检测方法，第二年其他学校照着做了。

col: pioneer a method｜开创一种方法
tip: 名词是开拓者。动词 pioneered 表示率先做。少先队员的称呼另有 Young Pioneer。

senses.en: a condition around an event
the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation

ex.en: Under no circumstance should you lie.
ex.zh: 在任何情况下你都不该说谎。

ex.en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
ex.zh: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。

col: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下
tip: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

senses.en: stated clearly, with nothing left implied

ex.en: The teacher was explicit about the deadline.
ex.zh: 老师把截止日期说得很明确。

ex.en: Please be explicit about which chart you mean, so the group does not argue later.
ex.zh: 请说清楚你指的是哪张图，免得小组过后再争。

tip: explicit 是把话说透。反义 vague 含糊。副词 explicitly。

senses.en: tasting very good; informal

ex.en: This stew tastes yummy.
ex.zh: 这道炖菜很好吃。

ex.en: Yummy is fine among friends, but a formal report should say delicious or tasty instead.
ex.zh: 朋友之间说 yummy 可以，正式报告里应当改说 delicious 或 tasty。

tip: yummy 是口语。书面作文用 delicious 或 tasty。它是形容词，不要当副词用。

senses.en: a cover for a pot, box, or jar

ex.en: Put the lid back on the paint.
ex.zh: 把油漆的盖子盖回去。

ex.en: A loose lid let the soup splash, so the cook pressed it down before walking.
ex.zh: 盖子松了，汤洒出来，厨师先把它按紧再走。

col: keep the lid on｜盖上盖子
tip: lid 是容器的盖。眼皮是 eyelid，不是 lid 单独表示。

senses.en: fine; easily broken
Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence.
Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.

ex.en: Handle the glass with delicate care.
ex.zh: 轻拿轻放这些玻璃。

ex.en: Tourism in coastal regions must be carefully managed to protect delicate ecosystems from lasting damage.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的旅游业必须得到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的生态系统免遭长期破坏。

col: delicate negotiations｜需谨慎进行的谈判
tip: 既可形容易损物品，也可形容需谨慎处理的问题。

senses.en: to break a law, rule, or agreement

ex.en: Closed-lab hours are easy to violate by mistake.
ex.zh: 实验室关闭时段很容易被人不小心违反。

ex.en: Cameras that violate the privacy rule are switched off before the meeting starts.
ex.zh: 违反隐私规定的摄像头在会议开始前关掉。

tip: violate a rule / the law。名词 violation。本卡只谈规章和法律，不写伤害别人的做法。
note: 只收违反规则、法律、协议。

senses.en: a person whose work is teaching or education

ex.en: The educator visited three classrooms.
ex.zh: 这位教育工作者走访了三间教室。

ex.en: An educator designs the task so that a wrong answer still teaches the next step.
ex.zh: 教育工作者设计任务时，会让一个错误答案仍然能教出下一步。

col: a science educator｜科学教育工作者
tip: educate 和 education 已在库里。educator 比 teacher 范围更广，可以包括课程设计者。

senses.en: to do what a person or rule says

ex.en: Players must obey the line judge.
ex.zh: 队员必须服从边裁。

ex.en: If you obey the fire plan, leave your bags and walk out. Do not run.
ex.zh: 要是遵守消防方案，就把包留下，走出去。不要跑。

tip: obey sb / obey a rule，后面直接加宾语。名词 obedience，反义词 disobey。

senses.en: to tell apart
to make someone or something different from others
to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it

ex.en: Babies learn to distinguish colors early.
ex.zh: 婴儿很早就能学会辨别颜色。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish reliable evidence from personal opinion when evaluating information online.
ex.zh: 学生在评估网络信息时，应学会区分可靠证据与个人观点。

col: distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开
tip: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

senses.en: a style of cooking

ex.en: Sichuan cuisine can be very hot.
ex.zh: 川菜可以很辣。

ex.en: The food fair puts local cuisine on one side and bread from the port city on the other.
ex.zh: 美食节一边是本地菜，另一边是港口城市的面包。

tip: cuisine 指一个地方或风格的菜，比 cooking 更正式。前面常加地方名。

senses.en: a small common brown bird

ex.en: A sparrow sat on the rail.
ex.zh: 一只麻雀停在栏杆上。

ex.en: Sparrows gathered near the canteen bins, and the guard asked students not to feed them.
ex.zh: 麻雀聚集在食堂垃圾桶附近，警卫请学生不要喂它们。

tip: sparrow 是麻雀。复数 sparrows。喂野生鸟通常不被鼓励，尤其是在食堂附近。

senses.en: a private teacher, or a teacher who guides a student

ex.en: My tutor checked the essay plan.
ex.zh: 我的导师看过了文章提纲。

ex.en: A weekend tutor can explain one weak topic, but the student still has to finish the practice alone.
ex.zh: 周末的辅导老师可以讲清一个薄弱知识点，但练习仍得学生自己做完。

tip: tutor 可以是家教，也可以是大学里的导师。动词 tutor sb in sth 是辅导某人某科。

senses.en: real, not a copy

ex.en: The museum label says the coin is authentic.
ex.zh: 博物馆标签写着这枚硬币是真品。

ex.en: The coach wants an authentic signature on the form, not a name typed in a box.
ex.zh: 教练要表格上有真实签名，不是在格子里打出来的名字。

tip: authentic 表示不是仿造的。副词 authentically，名词 authenticity。

senses.en: in a genuine, honest way

ex.en: I sincerely hope you feel better soon.
ex.zh: 我真心希望你快点好起来。

ex.en: She sincerely thanked the stranger, then wrote his name so she would not forget it.
ex.zh: 她真诚地谢过那位陌生人，然后写下他的名字，免得忘掉。

tip: 信的结尾 Yours sincerely 用在知道对方姓名时。形容词是 sincere。

senses.en: able to change easily
able to bend easily without breaking

ex.en: Keep a flexible schedule.
ex.zh: 保持灵活的时间安排。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。

col: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间
tip: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

senses.en: a round juicy fruit with a large stone

ex.en: A ripe peach smells sweet.
ex.zh: 熟桃子闻着是甜的。

ex.en: She cut the peach in half, removed the stone, and shared the fruit with her niece.
ex.zh: 她把桃子切成两半，去掉核，分给侄女吃。

tip: 复数 peaches。桃核是 stone 或 pit。桃花是 peach blossom。

senses.en: a person you work with

ex.en: A colleague saved me a seat in the hall.
ex.zh: 一位同事在礼堂给我留了座位。

ex.en: She asked a colleague to read the figures before the meeting, so the chart would be accurate.
ex.zh: 她请同事在会前核对数字，好让图表准确。

col: a colleague of mine｜我的一位同事
tip: 同事是 colleague。同学是 classmate，不要混。

senses.en: a feeling of worry

ex.en: Exam anxiety is common among students.
ex.zh: 考试焦虑在学生中很常见。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。

tip: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

senses.en: to give something and receive something else

ex.en: Can I swap seats with you?
ex.zh: 我能和你换座位吗？

ex.en: They swap books every Friday, and each person writes one line inside the cover.
ex.zh: 他们每周五换书，每人在封面里写一行字。

col: swap sth with sb｜与某人交换
tip: swap 是口语里的交换。过去式 swapped，p 要双写。

senses.en: a serious disagreement
A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree.
To disagree with or be incompatible with something.

ex.en: Talking can reduce family conflict.
ex.zh: 沟通可以减少家庭冲突。

ex.en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。

col: a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a period when many people are angry and public order is weak

ex.en: The chapter describes urban unrest.
ex.zh: 这一章描述城市里的动荡。

ex.en: Historians study the unrest through diaries and newspapers, and the essay must separate facts from slogans.
ex.zh: 历史学者通过日记和报纸研究那场动荡，文章必须把事实和口号分开。

tip: unrest 不可数，多用于历史或新闻。写作时陈述事实，不要把它写成行动指南。

senses.en: to love and admire someone or something deeply

ex.en: The children adore the old storyteller.
ex.zh: 孩子们非常喜欢这位老讲故事的人。

ex.en: She adores early mornings at the market, when the fish is still on ice.
ex.zh: 她热爱市场的清晨，那时鱼还放在冰上。

tip: adore 比 like 强得多。adore doing sth。名词 adoration。

senses.en: to become smaller, often after washing or from fear
the process of becoming smaller

ex.en: Hot water will shrink this sweater.
ex.zh: 热水会把这件毛衣缩水。

ex.en: The lake shrank in August, and the boat club moved its rope to a nearer post.
ex.zh: 湖面八月缩小了，划船社团把绳子改系到更近的桩上。

col: shrink in the wash｜洗后缩水
tip: 过去式 shrank，过去分词 shrunk。毛衣缩水用 shrink。口语里把心理医生叫 shrink 不是本卡的义项。

senses.en: an unmarried man, or a first university degree

ex.en: He is a bachelor and cooks for himself.
ex.zh: 他是单身，自己做饭。

ex.en: He holds a bachelor of science degree, and the form asks which subject he finished.
ex.zh: 他有理学学士学位，表格问他读完的是哪个专业。

tip: 学士是 bachelor's degree。未婚女子不是 bachelor。

senses.en: a good moral quality

ex.en: Patience is a virtue in a long queue.
ex.zh: 排长队时，耐心是一种美德。

ex.en: The speech praised honesty as a virtue, then gave two examples from school life.
ex.zh: 演讲把诚实誉为美德，接着举了校园生活里的两个例子。

tip: by virtue of 表示凭借，比 because of 正式。

senses.en: a narrow passage of water between two pieces of land

ex.en: The strait is narrow but deep.
ex.zh: 这条海峡又窄又深。

ex.en: Ships cross the strait at marked times, which the map shows with a thin blue line.
ex.zh: 船只在标出的时间穿过海峡，地图上用一条细蓝线表示。

tip: strait 是海峡，和 straight（直的）拼写不同。处于困境可以说 in dire straits，那是引申。

senses.en: to send out by radio or TV
A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The match will broadcast live tonight.
ex.zh: 比赛今晚将直播。

ex.en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
ex.zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

senses.en: a unit of liquid, about 0.57 litres in Britain

ex.en: Please buy a pint of milk.
ex.zh: 请买一品脱牛奶。

ex.en: A British pint is a little more than half a litre, which the recipe card shows beside the cup size.
ex.zh: 英制品脱比半升略多，食谱卡片在杯子容量旁边标出了这一点。

col: a pint of milk｜一品脱牛奶
tip: pint 是容量单位。英制大约 0.57 升。课堂例句用牛奶或配方，不拿它当酒的量词来用。

senses.en: a shape with three straight sides

ex.en: Draw a triangle and mark the right angle.
ex.zh: 画一个三角形，并标出直角。

ex.en: The roof forms a triangle, which is why rain runs off both sides so quickly.
ex.zh: 屋顶构成一个三角形，所以雨水从两侧流得很快。

tip: 三角形是 triangle。角是 angle。三边是 three sides。

senses.en: a sour liquid used in cooking

ex.en: A spoon of vinegar lifts the soup.
ex.zh: 一勺醋让汤的味道提起来了。

ex.en: Rice vinegar is milder than the dark kind, which the cooking note explains beside the salt.
ex.zh: 米醋比深色的醋更温和，烹饪说明在盐的旁边写了这一点。

tip: vinegar 不可数。酸是 sour。中餐里的醋和西餐色拉醋都可以用这个词。

senses.en: to provide what is needed for a task

ex.en: The lab will equip every group with goggles.
ex.zh: 实验室会给每组配护目镜。

ex.en: Good courses equip students with methods they can reuse, not only with facts for one test.
ex.zh: 好的课程让学生具备可以再用的方法，而不只是应付一次考试的事实。

tip: equip sb with sth。名词 equipment 已在库里，不可数。过去式 equipped 要双写 p。

senses.en: not stained by rust, or free from a moral stain

ex.en: Use the stainless pot for the soup.
ex.zh: 汤用那口不锈钢锅。

ex.en: Stainless steel spoons stay bright, while the old iron ones mark the cloth.
ex.zh: 不锈钢勺子一直发亮，旧铁勺会在布上留下印。

tip: stainless steel 是不锈钢。stain 是污渍或动词「沾污」。

senses.en: suffering or death caused by a lack of food

ex.en: The text defines starvation carefully.
ex.zh: 课文小心地下了挨饿的定义。

ex.en: The geography unit describes starvation as a dangerous lack of food and asks how supplies reach a village.
ex.zh: 地理单元把挨饿写成危险的食物匮乏，并问物资怎样送到村里。

tip: starvation 是严重缺乏食物。口语里 I'm starving 只是很饿，和真正的 starvation 不是一回事。写作要分清。

senses.en: an oven that cooks with microwaves, or those waves themselves

ex.en: Reheat yesterday's rice in the microwave.
ex.zh: 把昨天的米饭放进微波炉里热一热。

ex.en: Do not put metal in the microwave, even if the bowl looks safe from the outside.
ex.zh: 不要把金属放进微波炉，哪怕碗从外面看是安全的。

tip: 日常说 the microwave 就是微波炉。金属不能放进去。微波本身是物理名词。

senses.en: violent and aggressive, or very strong

ex.en: A fierce wind bent the young trees.
ex.zh: 猛烈的风把小树吹弯了。

ex.en: The debate grew fierce, yet both sides still listened when the chair asked for quiet.
ex.zh: 辩论变得激烈，但主席要求安静时双方仍然听着。

tip: fierce 可以形容动物、风，也可以形容竞争或争论。

senses.en: easy to carry

ex.en: This portable radio fits in a school bag.
ex.zh: 这台便携收音机能放进书包。

ex.en: A portable charger kept the recording going when the hall had no socket near the stage.
ex.zh: 礼堂舞台边没有插座，便携充电器让录音得以继续。

tip: portable 强调搬得动。口袋大小更常说 pocket。

senses.en: the reflexive form of you when you means more than one

ex.en: Please time yourselves on this page.
ex.zh: 请给自己计时做这一页。

ex.en: If the map is unclear, work it out yourselves and then compare the route with the other pair.
ex.zh: 地图如果看不清，你们自己先把它弄明白，再和另一组对路线。

tip: yourselves 是 you 的复数反身代词。一个人用 yourself，不要写成 yourselfs。

senses.en: unable to stop doing something

ex.en: He is addicted to late-night videos.
ex.zh: 他迷上了深夜看视频。

ex.en: Once you are addicted to a game, set a clock and leave the screen when it rings.
ex.zh: 一旦迷上某个游戏，就定个钟，铃响了就离开屏幕。

tip: 人用 addicted，事物使人上瘾用 addictive。be addicted to sth / doing。本卡只谈学习和生活习惯。
note: 只收校园里的入迷、依赖。不写任何吸毒做法。

senses.en: a race in which each person covers one part
to pass on news or a broadcast

ex.en: Our class won the relay by a stride.
ex.zh: 我们班以一步的优势赢了接力。

ex.en: Please relay the new gate time to the other team, because their coach has no signal on the field.
ex.zh: 请把新的入场时间转达给另一队，他们的教练在场地上没有信号。

tip: 名词是接力赛。动词 relay sth to sb 是转达。接力棒叫 baton。

senses.en: a small house, especially in the country

ex.en: The reading camp is in a cottage by the lake.
ex.zh: 阅读营在湖边的一间小屋里。

ex.en: The cottage had a low door, and the tallest student had to bend to enter.
ex.zh: 小屋的门很矮，最高的学生得弯腰才能进去。

tip: cottage 是乡下的小屋。城里的公寓不是 cottage。

senses.en: to forbid something officially

ex.en: Local law prohibits fires on this hill.
ex.zh: 当地法规禁止在这座山上点火。

ex.en: Signs prohibit visitors from touching the models, and a guard repeats the rule at the door.
ex.zh: 标牌禁止参观者触摸模型，门口的警卫会再重复一遍。

tip: prohibit sb from doing，不说 prohibit to do。forbid 也可以表示禁止，结构是 forbid sb to do。prohibit 更正式。

senses.en: a sticky substance used to join things
to join things with that substance

ex.en: This glue dries clear on paper.
ex.zh: 这种胶水在纸上干了是透明的。

ex.en: Glue the photo at the corners only, so you can lift it later without tearing the page.
ex.zh: 只在四角抹胶水，以后揭照片才不会把这一页撕破。

col: a tube of glue｜一管胶水
glue sth together｜把某物粘在一起
tip: glue 可数时是一种胶或一管胶，也可以作动词。液体胶水常不可数。

senses.en: to hit one's hands together to show approval

ex.en: We clap when the choir finishes.
ex.zh: 合唱结束时我们鼓掌。

ex.en: Do not clap during the quiet movement; wait until the conductor lowers both hands.
ex.zh: 安静的乐章进行时不要鼓掌，等指挥把双手放下。

col: a round of clapping｜一阵掌声
tip: clap 是拍手。applaud 更正式，可以不用手而用言语称赞。过去式 clapped。

senses.en: towards the back; in the reverse order

ex.en: He spelled his name backwards as a joke.
ex.zh: 他开玩笑把自己的名字倒着拼。

ex.en: The video plays backwards if you hold this key, and the dancer seems to rise from the floor.
ex.zh: 按住这个键，视频会倒放，舞者好像从地板上站起来。

tip: 考纲里 backward 与 backwards 都单列。参考表写成 backward(s)，音标没有词尾的 /z/，本卡按 backwards 收尾补上。

senses.en: the purpose of something
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: What is the function of this button?
ex.zh: 这个按钮的功能是什么？

ex.en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
ex.zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: an official paper showing you have finished a course

ex.en: She framed the diploma above the desk.
ex.zh: 她把文凭裱起来挂在书桌上方。

ex.en: The diploma arrives by post next month, so the ceremony itself does not hand you the paper.
ex.zh: 文凭下个月寄到，典礼当天并不把证书交到你手上。

col: a high school diploma｜高中文凭
tip: diploma 是学历证书。diplomacy 是外交，词根相近但意思不同，不要混。

senses.en: a game in which you roll a ball at pins

ex.en: Our class booked a lane for bowling on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们班星期五订了一条保龄球道。

ex.en: Bowling looks easy until you try to hit the last pin without stepping over the line.
ex.zh: 保龄球看起来容易，等你试着不越线击中最后一只瓶就知道了。

tip: bowling 是这项运动。碗是 bowl。go bowling 中间没有 to。

senses.en: completely unreasonable or silly

ex.en: The rumour about the exam is absurd.
ex.zh: 关于考试的那个传闻很荒谬。

ex.en: It is absurd to blame the rain for a mistake that was written into the plan.
ex.zh: 计划里写错的东西，却怪到下雨头上，这太荒谬了。

tip: absurd 语气重，表示完全说不通。名词 absurdity。

senses.en: a worry or interest

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
senses.en: An issue that matters or causes worry
To relate to someone or something, or cause worry

ex.en: Health is a shared concern for all.
ex.zh: 健康是所有人共同的关切。

ex.en: Growing concern about air pollution has encouraged many cities to invest in cleaner public transport systems.
ex.zh: 人们对空气污染日益担忧，促使许多城市投资建设更清洁的公共交通系统。

col: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧
a major concern｜一个主要问题
concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

senses.en: to refuse to buy something or take part, as a protest
that kind of protest

ex.en: Some readers boycott the unfair magazine.
ex.zh: 有些读者抵制那份不公平的杂志。

ex.en: The boycott of plastic bottles lasted a month and pushed the canteen to offer jugs of water.
ex.zh: 抵制塑料瓶持续了一个月，食堂因此改供应大壶水。

col: call for a boycott｜呼吁抵制
tip: boycott 可作动词或名词。它是公开的集体拒绝，不是偷偷破坏。

senses.en: required by a rule, not left to choice

ex.en: Lab goggles are compulsory here.
ex.zh: 这里必须戴实验护目镜。

ex.en: Sports day is compulsory for every class, though students who are ill can bring a note from the clinic.
ex.zh: 运动会每班都得参加，生病的学生可以带校医室的证明。

tip: compulsory 后面常接名词。be compulsory for sb 表示某人必须做。反义是 optional。

senses.en: a formal style of dancing on the toes

ex.en: She has ballet practice on Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 她周四晚上练芭蕾。

ex.en: The school ballet tells an old story, and the dancers made their own paper trees.
ex.zh: 学校的芭蕾讲一个老故事，舞者自己做了纸树。

tip: 芭蕾的 t 不发音，末尾读 /eɪ/。

senses.en: deserving respect and approval

ex.en: Her patience is admirable.
ex.zh: 她的耐心令人钦佩。

ex.en: It was admirable of him to share the notes, even though he had finished them late the night before.
ex.zh: 他能把笔记分给别人，这很可敬，尽管那些笔记是前一天夜里很晚才写完的。

tip: admire 已在库里，是动词。admirable 是形容词。It is admirable of sb to do 是常见句型。

senses.en: based on theory, not on practice

ex.en: The theoretical result did not match the lab reading.
ex.zh: 理论结果和实验读数对不上。

ex.en: A theoretical model is useful only if someone later tests it with real data.
ex.zh: 理论模型只有后来有人用真实数据检验，才有用。

tip: theoretical 对 practical。名词 theory。

senses.en: to agree to do a task, or to start it

ex.en: We undertake the cleaning every Friday.
ex.zh: 我们每个星期五负责打扫。

ex.en: The college will undertake a survey of the playground before any new paint is bought.
ex.zh: 学院会在购买新涂料之前先对操场做调查。

col: undertake a task｜承担一项任务
tip: undertake to do sth 是答应去做。过去式 undertook，过去分词 undertaken。

senses.en: to break out of an egg, or to make an egg do that
an opening in a ship or aircraft floor

ex.en: The chicks hatch near the warm lamp.
ex.zh: 小鸡在暖灯旁出壳。

ex.en: Three eggs hatch by Friday, and the farmer will move those chicks into a dry box.
ex.zh: 有三枚蛋星期五孵出来，农场主会把那些小鸡挪进干燥的箱子。

col: hatch a plan｜策划一个计划
tip: 第一义是孵出。hatch a plan 是暗中策划。名词 hatch 还可指船上的舱口。

senses.en: a small piece of thick material that lies on the floor or a table

ex.en: Leave wet shoes on the mat.
ex.zh: 湿鞋放在垫子上。

ex.en: He rolled the exercise mat after practice so nobody would trip in the dark corridor.
ex.zh: 训练后他把运动垫卷起来，免得有人在暗走廊里绊倒。

tip: mat 是小垫子。床垫是 mattress，大得多。不要和 maths 混在一个词里。

senses.en: to move an event to a later time

ex.en: We postponed the match until Monday.
ex.zh: 我们把比赛推迟到周一。

ex.en: They postponed printing the paper until the missing chart arrived, rather than guessing the numbers.
ex.zh: 他们把报纸的付印推迟到缺失的图送到之后，而不是去猜那些数字。

tip: postpone 后接名词或 doing，不说 postpone to do。推迟到某时用 until 或 to。反义可以是 bring forward。

senses.en: unable to walk well, or weak as an excuse

ex.en: The lame dog waited by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 那只跛脚的狗等在厨房门口。

ex.en: Saying he forgot the date is a lame excuse, because the notice has been up all week.
ex.zh: 说自己忘了日期站不住脚，通知已经贴了整整一周。

col: a lame excuse｜站不住脚的借口
lame in one leg｜一条腿瘸
tip: 形容腿是跛。形容借口是站不住脚。后一种很常见。

senses.en: a branch of mathematics that uses letters for numbers

ex.en: Algebra uses letters for unknown numbers.
ex.zh: 代数用字母表示未知数。

ex.en: In algebra we solve for x, and we show each step so a classmate can follow it.
ex.zh: 代数课上我们求 x，并且把每一步写出来，让同学跟得上。

tip: 学科名前通常不加 the：study algebra。形容词 algebraic。

senses.en: a small change that makes something better

ex.en: One adjustment made the chair comfortable.
ex.zh: 调了一下，椅子就舒服了。

ex.en: A small adjustment to the timetable let the lab group finish before the bus left.
ex.zh: 时间表稍作调整，实验小组就能在车开走前做完。

tip: adjustment 是名词。动词 adjust 已在本库。

senses.en: written forms and records that a job requires

ex.en: The paperwork took the whole afternoon.
ex.zh: 文书工作占了整整一下午。

ex.en: Finish the paperwork before Friday, or the exchange office cannot hold your place.
ex.zh: 星期五之前把文书做完，否则交流办公室留不住你的名额。

tip: paperwork 不可数。一份表格是 a form，成堆的手续才是 paperwork。

senses.en: a thin cloud near the ground that is lighter than fog

ex.en: Morning mist hid the far goal.
ex.zh: 晨雾挡住了远处的球门。

ex.en: The mist lifted before the ferry left, so passengers could see both banks of the river.
ex.zh: 渡船离开前雾散了，乘客能看见河的两岸。

col: lost in the mist｜消失在雾中
tip: mist 比 fog 更薄。形容词是 misty。不要和 missed（错过）弄混。

senses.en: clothes to be washed, or a place that washes them

ex.en: The dorm laundry closes at nine.
ex.zh: 宿舍洗衣房九点关门。

ex.en: Her laundry was still damp at breakfast, so she wore yesterday's shirt.
ex.zh: 早饭时她要洗的衣服还是潮的，于是她穿了昨天的衬衫。

tip: laundry 既可以是待洗的衣服，也可以是洗衣的地方。

senses.en: a small long soft creature with no legs

ex.en: A worm crossed the wet path.
ex.zh: 一条蚯蚓爬过湿漉漉的小路。

ex.en: Birds pull a worm from the soil after rain, which the biology note asks you to describe.
ex.zh: 雨后鸟会从土里拽出蚯蚓，生物笔记让你描写这一点。

col: a worm in the apple｜苹果里的虫
tip: 蚯蚓常说 earthworm，泛指小软虫用 worm。电脑里的 worm 是蠕虫病毒，看上下文。

senses.en: the state of being away
a situation in which something does not exist or occur

ex.en: His absence from class worried the teacher.
ex.zh: 他缺课让老师担心。

ex.en: In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
ex.zh: 在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。

col: in someone's absence｜在某人不在时
in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下
tip: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

senses.en: an adult male of the cattle family, often used for farm work

ex.en: An ox stood in the old photo.
ex.zh: 旧照片里站着一头牛。

ex.en: One ox can pull a wooden cart, which the museum model shows beside the rice tools.
ex.zh: 一头牛可以拉木车，博物馆的模型把它放在稻作农具旁边。

col: strong as an ox｜力大如牛
tip: 复数是 oxen，不是 oxes。泛指牛常用 cattle 或 cow。ox 常强调役用的公牛。

senses.en: a person who carries bags, or who watches a door

ex.en: The porter carried our bags to the train.
ex.zh: 搬运工把行李送到了火车上。

ex.en: Ask the porter at the gate whether the hall stays open after nine.
ex.zh: 问问门口的门房，礼堂九点后还开不开。

tip: 车站帮你拿箱子的，和守门的，考纲里都可以是 porter。

senses.en: a place where a dead person is buried, often with a stone

ex.en: The old tomb is closed to visitors.
ex.zh: 那座古墓不对参观者开放。

ex.en: Flowers on the tomb are replaced each spring by students from the nearest school.
ex.zh: 墓上的花每年春天由最近那所学校的学生更换。

tip: tomb 的 b 不发音。墓碑常说 tombstone，一个词。

senses.en: happening all the time
remaining the same over time
a value or quantity that does not change

ex.en: There is constant noise from the street.
ex.zh: 街上有持续的噪音。

ex.en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑保持恒温可以提高舒适度，但可能增加能源消耗。

tip: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

senses.en: made by people, not natural
Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour

ex.en: artificial light can hurt sleep.
ex.zh: 人造光可能影响睡眠。

ex.en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
ex.zh: 城市中过量的人工照明会扰乱野生动物的行为，并使星星难以看清。

tip: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

senses.en: a brown powder from cocoa beans, or a hot drink made from it

ex.en: Hot cocoa warmed our hands.
ex.zh: 热可可暖了我们的手。

ex.en: The cook mixed cocoa with milk rather than water, so the drink was thick enough for a cold morning.
ex.zh: 厨师用牛奶而不是水来调可可，所以冷天早上这杯饮料够浓。

tip: cocoa 是可可粉或可可饮料。巧克力是 chocolate，原料相关，但不是同一个词。

senses.en: to give out
to spread something over an area

ex.en: Volunteers distribute food to the poor.
ex.zh: 志愿者向穷人分发食物。

ex.en: Governments must distribute healthcare resources fairly so that rural communities receive the same quality of care as urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府必须公平分配医疗资源，让农村社区享有与城市居民同等质量的医疗服务。

tip: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

senses.en: to give for a purpose
To help cause a particular result
To write material for a publication or website

ex.en: Everyone can contribute to the project.
ex.zh: 每个人都能为这个项目做贡献。

ex.en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
ex.zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。

col: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论
contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长
tip: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: total; complete
not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities

ex.en: He has absolute confidence in the team.
ex.zh: 他对团队有绝对信心。

ex.en: Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
ex.zh: 赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。

col: an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

senses.en: to gather or increase gradually

ex.en: Dust can accumulate under the bed.
ex.zh: 灰尘会在床底下越积越多。

ex.en: Small errors accumulate if nobody checks the sum, and the final chart then misleads the class.
ex.zh: 如果没人核对总数，小错误就会累积，最后的图表便会误导全班。

tip: accumulate 强调逐渐变多。名词 accumulation。人积累经验，灰尘也会 accumulate。

senses.en: a person who speaks officially for a group

ex.en: The spokesman read a short statement.
ex.zh: 发言人宣读了一份简短声明。

ex.en: A spokesman for the museum said the dinosaur hall will reopen after the roof is dry.
ex.zh: 博物馆发言人说，屋顶干了以后恐龙馆会重新开放。

tip: spokesman 传统上指男性。女性是 spokeswoman，中性说法是 spokesperson。复数 spokesmen。

senses.en: to travel on water using sails or a boat
a sheet of cloth that catches the wind

ex.en: They sail on the lake when the wind is steady.
ex.zh: 风稳定时他们在湖上航行。

ex.en: A red sail showed beyond the pier, then disappeared behind the boathouse.
ex.zh: 码头外露出一面红帆，然后消失在船库后面。

tip: 本卡动词在前。帆是名词 sail。开船的人是 sailor，不要和 sail 当成同一个词。
